milestone: Actual-state rolling prediction of the existing feedback policy
model: Known-track ideal-state kinematic bicycle; Pure Pursuit and bounded speed feedback
timing_scope: Two 3-second forecasts at 20 m/s on the reference Windows host; no real-time guarantee
limitations: Forecast predicts the baseline policy; future points do not optimize its first action
Known track provides guidance beyond the visible horizon; no perception or obstacle avoidance
No mass sensitivity, tire slip, wheel locking, ABS or minimum-time racing optimization
Schema 1 does not record rolling predictions; replay explicitly hides them
